title: P2P bitcoin lending service BTCjam shuts down
notes: Contemporaneous report reproducing BTCJam's closure notice and FAQ: no new loans, active borrowers could keep repaying, repayment functionality would remain until loans were fully repaid or defaulted, and stored BTC could be withdrawn until 2018-07-01. This supports a controlled wind-down model. It does not prove that every borrower repaid, every lender recovered fully, or every stored balance was withdrawn.

title: Bitcoin lending platform BTCJam announces closure
notes: Independent contemporaneous reproduction of BTCJam's closure statement confirms the 2018-07-01 stored-BTC withdrawal deadline and continued repayment functionality until active loans were repaid or defaulted. Loan-level defaults remain borrower outcomes rather than evidence of platform insolvency.
